_: The Resume Field Set — what each field id MEANS and what a human calls it. Lifted verbatim from apps/ai-service/app/profiling/rfs.py before OIE Phase 8 deleted it.
_why_json: Data, not code, for the same reason particles.json and persona.json are: a reviewer adds or rewords a field by editing this file, and both the TypeScript and Python readers see the change without either being redeployed against a constant the other does not have.
_guide: Deliberately phrased as the INFORMATION wanted, never as a question. Under the LLM interview this told the model what to collect; under the deterministic engine it is what a pack AUTHOR reads when writing the question, and what the parse prompt names when asking for a typed value. The wording survives the change of reader because it never described how to ask.
_label: A short, human label for a field id — the missing-field nudge, the ops console, and a log line. Never shown as a question either.
_no_identity_fields: There is deliberately NO field here for a name, phone, address or employer. The Resume Field Set is what a resume needs; identity is what §2 forbids collecting through this path. An id that is not in this file is not in the vocabulary, and gate 5 drops it.

trade.label: trade
trade.guide: what work they do, in their own words

skills.label: skills
skills.guide: what they can actually do - tasks, machines, tools, software, materials

experience_years.label: experience
experience_years.guide: how long they have done this work (a number of years)

current_city.label: current city
current_city.guide: the city they are in now

preferred_locations.label: preferred locations
preferred_locations.guide: where they want to work (may differ from where they are)

salary_expected.label: expected salary
salary_expected.guide: the pay they want, and per month or per day

availability.label: availability
availability.guide: when they can start, or their notice period

tools_equipment.label: tools/equipment
tools_equipment.guide: specific machines, tools, vehicles or software they operate

education_field.label: field of study
education_field.guide: their stream or trade of study

certifications.label: certifications
certifications.guide: certificates, licences or trade tickets they hold

work_history.label: work history
work_history.guide: roles held and for how long (NEVER the employer's name)

relocation_willingness.label: relocation
relocation_willingness.guide: whether they would move city for work
